jobs.title: Group Design Platform Software & AI Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
### **Transform with us the future of****energy**


The **SGB‑SMIT Group** is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in **Europe, Asia** and **America**. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.


As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, **SGB‑SMIT Group** develops and manufactures **power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers** and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.


With more than **3,800 employees** worldwide, the **SGB‑SMIT Group** stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

#### **What sets the SGB\-SMIT Group apart****:**


We combine the strength of an **international technology company** with an **employee\-oriented corporate culture**:

* Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition
* Short decision\-making processes and direct cooperation
* Stable, growing company with long\-term prospects


Your contribution counts – **both professionally and personally**.

#### **Your benefits at SGB\-SMIT Group:**

* Stable, growing company with long\-term prospects
* Attractive salary and social benefits
* Flexible working hours and hybrid working models
* 30\+1 vacation days plus special leave
* Training and development opportunities
* Company pension plan and employee insurance
* Health and fitness offers (HanseFit)
* Company restaurant, free drinks, and e\-charging parking spaces
* Bicycle and IT leasing
* Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket
* Employee discounts via Benify

#### **Your tasks:**

* Define and continuously develop the software and implementation architecture of our Group Design Platform, including modules, interfaces, data ownership and technical roadmaps.
* Provide technical leadership for the existing C\#/.NET environment and guide its development toward scalable, maintainable and testable solutions.
* Evaluate technical alternatives, dependencies and risks, and document architecture decisions and recommendations transparently.
* Establish software development standards for coding, APIs, data models, automated testing, versioning, documentation and code reviews.
* Identify and assess AI use cases, technologies and models, and guide the implementation of selected AI\-enabled platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, project managers, engineering experts, users and development teams to deliver appropriate technical solutions.
* Review software designs, critical code, integration concepts and supplier proposals to ensure compliance with the platform architecture.
* Drive modernization, refactoring, performance improvement, cybersecurity and technical\-debt reduction while supporting Agile/Scrum and stage\-gate processes

#### **Your profile:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
* At least eight years of professional software development experience, including several years in software architecture or technical leadership.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in C\# and the .NET ecosystem, ideally gained in complex engineering, desktop, web or service applications.
* In\-depth knowledge of software architecture, domain\-driven design, modular architectures, design patterns, APIs, data architecture and system integration.
* Practical experience with AI\-enabled software, model integration, data pipelines, workflow orchestration, evaluation, monitoring and governance.
* Good knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, release pipelines and secure software development.
* Strong analytical, communication, mentoring and stakeholder\-management skills, combined with the ability to guide distributed and external development teams.
* English skills at C1 level or equivalent. Knowledge of German and experience with industrial engineering software, PLM, CAD, SAP, databases or cloud architectures are additional advantages.


If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands\-on work, then become part of the **SGB\-SMIT Group** \- **transform with us the future of****energy**.


We look forward to receiving your application!


Learn more about the SGB\-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page:


https://www.sgb\-smit.com/career\-jobs/sgb\-smit\-group\#/

*The terms used in this text refer to all genders in accordance with the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG).*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications - Ratings Technology (Manchester)
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 50696
Business Unit: Fitch Group
Category: Information Technology
Location:
Manchester, GB
Date Posted: Sep 21, 2026
As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

  

**Senior Software Engineer, Full\-Stack Applications – Ratings Technology**

  

Fitch Ratings is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to join our global Ratings Technology team in **Manchester**. This is your opportunity to not just build mission\-critical applications, but to **shape the future direction** of technology that powers how a world\-leading credit ratings agency delivers insights. Your leadership, architectural decisions, and vision will directly impact analysts, executives, and decision\-makers who shape global financial markets.


You'll work closely with our talented engineering teams supporting Ratings workflow and analytical applications, influencing both **technical architecture and organizational direction**. We're looking for a **seasoned technologist who thrives on challenging assumptions, experimenting with emerging technologies (especially AI), and pushing boundaries**—not an MLE or AI specialist, but a full\-stack engineer who's curious, unafraid to question the status quo, and excited to explore how AI can transform analytical workflows, as well as delivering high quality user experiences in their applications. This is a **critical role** for an organization expanding rapidly and building for the future, offering mobility and upward potential for the right visionary.

  

**What We Offer:**


* **Strategic leadership with organizational impact** – Shape technical architecture and product direction for applications used by analysts worldwide, with high visibility to senior leadership and the ability to influence technology strategy across Ratings Technology
* **Innovation\-first culture and experimentation** – Permission to challenge established patterns, explore emerging technologies including AI, and drive proof\-of\-concepts with access to cutting\-edge tools and a community that celebrates curiosity and bold thinking
* **Continuous learning and career growth** – Training, certifications, conferences, mentorship opportunities, and clear paths to principal/architect/leadership tracks as you establish yourself as a thought leader
* **Flexibility and world\-class environment** – Work from premier offices in London, Manchester, or Toronto with hybrid flexibility, competitive compensation reflecting your seniority, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values both innovation and work\-life harmony

  

**We'll Count on You To:**


* **Deliver technical excellence and build game\-changing solutions** – Design robust, scalable **full\-stack applications using Java/Springboot, C\#/.NET, Python and REACT**, drive architectural decisions, establish technical standards, and lead exploration of AI/ML integration opportunities that transform workflows
* **Offer influence and mentorship** – Partner with product managers, analysts, and senior stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, mentor engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and psychological safety
* **Challenge the status quo and drive innovation** – Question existing approaches, champion better solutions even when uncomfortable, experiment with emerging technologies, create proofs\-of\-concept, and push the organization toward what's possible rather than what's comfortable
* **Champion engineering excellence and quality** – Implement CI/CD pipelines, conduct architecture reviews, solve complex performance and scalability challenges, establish best practices that scale across teams, and balance innovation with pragmatic delivery
* **Shape organizational and team direction** – Influence team processes, lead strategic technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, bring fresh perspectives while respecting institutional knowledge, and model the curiosity, humility, and boldness needed across the organization
* **Own reliability and navigate complexity** – Provide expert troubleshooting for sophisticated issues, maintain system performance at scale, balance multiple strategic priorities, and deliver excellence in fast\-paced Agile environments

  

**What You Need to Have:**


* **Deep full\-stack engineering expertise** – 10\+ years of hands\-on experience building enterprise applications, with **expert\-level proficiency in Java/Springboot and/or C\#/.NET, good familiarity with Python, REACT** and modern web technologies in production environments.
* **Architectural mastery and technical depth** – Proven track record of designing maintainable, scalable systems; excellent understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and the ability to make architectural decisions and live with their consequences
* **Bachelor's degree** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* **Visionary problem\-solving and growth mindset** – Exceptional analytical abilities, demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, track record of experimentation and learning from failures, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives
* **Outstanding collaboration and communication skills** – Proven success with cross\-functional teams, ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, and emotional intelligence to navigate organizational dynamics

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**


* **Modern engineering practices and DevOps prowess** – Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and hands\-on cloud expertise with microservices and cloud\-native architecture
* **AI curiosity and exploration mindset** – Genuine interest in how AI/ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation could transform software delivery, business processes, systems and applications; experience experimenting with new technologies and evaluating practical applications; comfort with emerging technology ambiguity
* **Financial services domain expertise** – Experience with analytical workflows, regulatory processes, financial products, credit ratings, or understanding of how technology enables better decision\-making
* **Agile mastery and change agent experience** – Track record of establishing practices, challenging established patterns constructively, and creating space for teams to innovate and take calculated risks

  

**If you are a seasoned technologist with a passion for innovation, a desire to shape organizational direction, and the courage to question the status quo, we would love to hear from you!**

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**  

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* **A Culture of Learning \& Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning, financial wellness and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals
* **Promoting Health \& Wellness:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that prioritize a healthy body \& mind
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family\-first policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days and support for community engagement initiatives

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision\-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day\-to\-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI\-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

  

Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

  

\#LI\-KN1 \#LI\-GROUP \#LI\-HYBRID

jobs.title: Business Applications & Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Neptune Lines Shipping and Managing Enterprises (Neptune Lines), part of Neptune Group**, is a leading finished vehicle logistics provider, specializing in transportation and shipping solutions for manufacturers and shippers of cars and high and heavy cargoes. Operating across Europe, North Africa, and the Black Sea, Neptune Lines excels in short\-sea shipping, connecting ports with efficient and specialized services. As a trusted partner for major car manufacturers, Neptune Lines delivers tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards. Guided by its "Wake Forward" philosophy, Neptune Lines is committed to sustainability, reliability, and customer satisfaction, delivering operational excellence that drives progress in the logistics industry.

  

  

We are seeking a talented and tech\-savvy **Business Applications \& Support Engineer** to join our **Digital Transformation team**. You will play a key role in supporting, optimizing and continuously enhancing our core business systems and ERP applications. Acting as a vital link between technology, business operations, end\-users and external vendors, you will translate business needs into effective digital solutions, oversee system improvements and contribute to the successful delivery of transformation initiatives.

  

  

The position reports directly to the **Digital Transformation Manager**.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze, support and enhance core business systems and enterprise applications, including ERP systems, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and business requirements.
* Design and develop tailored in\-house applications or custom scripts, as required, to address specific business needs.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal end\-users and external software vendors, facilitating effective communication and accelerating issue resolution.
* Oversee system installations, upgrades and configurations carried out by external vendors, ensuring timely, efficient and high\-quality project delivery.
* Design and execute comprehensive end\-to\-end testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure system reliability and seamless performance.
* Deliver engaging training sessions and develop clear user documentation to support end\-users and promote the successful adoption of new technologies.
* Develop and deliver a wide range of reports, dashboards and data insights, supporting business continuity and providing Top Management with valuable information for decision\-making.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**


* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience: At least two years of relevant professional experience in application support, business analysis, ERP implementation or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English (a third language will be considered an asset).
  

  

**Skills**


* Strong hands\-on knowledge of relational database management systems, with particular emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL.
* Familiarity with at least one major programming language, such as Python, C\#, Java, PHP or VB.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Greek and English, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* A proactive and collaborative team player who can also work independently, quickly adapt to emerging technologies and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Experience with Business Intelligence tools, such as Power BI or QlikView, and the ability to transform raw data into meaningful and actionable dashboards will be considered an asset.
* Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and workflow automation tools, such as Power Automate or UiPath, will be considered an asset.
  

  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to ensuring that our employment practices do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other legally protected status. By applying, you agree to the Consent Form for the Processing of Personal Data(GDPR). More information can be found at: https://www.neptunelines.com/consent\-form\-processing\-personal\-data

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Die Rolle**


Du verfügst über tiefgehendes technisches Know\-How, denkst in nachhaltigen Softwarearchitekturen und möchtest die Weiterentwicklung moderner Anwendungen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres SCHUHFRIED Entwicklungsteams.  

  

In dieser Schlüsselrolle kombinierst Du Softwareentwicklung auf hohem fachlichem Niveau mit Unterstützung bei der Architekturverantwortung und begleitest das Team bei der Umsetzung zukunftsfähiger, skalierbarer Softwarelösungen.

#### **Die Aufgaben**

* Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösungen auf Basis von .NET, Angular und Azure
* Kontinuierliche Modernisierung bestehender Anwendungen und Architekturen
* Analyse fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen, Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungsansätze
* Enge Zusammenarbeit im multidisziplinären SCRUM Team
* Fachliche Unterstützung von Entwickler\*innen bei technischen Fragestellungen
* Technische Verantwortung für Qualität, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit unserer Anwendungen
* Mitwirkung bei Architektur und Designreviews sowie technischen Standards und Best Practices
* Mitgestaltung der technologischen Roadmap und Evaluierung neuer Technologien

#### **Das Profil**

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwarelösungen mit C\#/.NET und TypeScript
* Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von Azure Cloud Lösungen
* Kenntnisse in Datenbanksystemen (MS SQL Server, Azure SQL)
* Sicherer Umgang mit ASP.NET Core und Angular
* Erfahrung im Design von Softwarearchitekturen und verteilten Systemen
* Erfahrung mit C\+\+/Win32 von Vorteil
* Effektiver Einsatz von KI\-Tools wie Claude Code
* Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und Deutschkenntnisse

#### **Unser Angebot**

* Ein öffentlich gut angebundenes Büro in Mödling (Badner Bahn \& ÖBB) und einen großen Parkplatz für Mitarbeitende
* Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
* Sportangebote (myClubs) und zahlreiche Firmenevents
* Bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche
* Bis zu 5 Tage bezahlte Freistellung pro Jahr für soziales Engagement

#### **Warum wir?**


SCHUHFRIED ist ein international erfolgreicher Hidden Champion im Bereich der digitalen psychologischen Diagnostik. Seit über 79 Jahren entwickeln wir wissenschaftlich fundierte psychologische Tests, die weltweit in den Bereichen Eignungsdiagnostik, Klinische Neuropsychologie, Verkehrs\- und Sportpsychologie eingesetzt werden.  

  

In unserem Unternehmen werden Werte wie Verantwortung, Vertrauen und Zusammenhalt gelebt. Es erwarten dich kurze Entscheidungswege, abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten und ein freundliches und offenes Arbeitsumfeld. Gerne geben wir dir in einem persönlichen Gespräch einen genaueren Einblick in die Bereiche, in denen unsere Produkte zum Einsatz kommen.  

  

Uns ist auch wichtig, hervorzuheben, dass wir Diversität in unserem Unternehmen in Bezug auf unsere Mitarbeitenden schätzen. Alle sind herzlich willkommen \- unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Ethnizität und sexueller Orientierung.

#### **Gehalt**


Laut Kollektivvertrag liegt das Bruttomonatsgehalt für diese Vollzeitposition (38,5 Std.) bei € 4\.190,57, wobei die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung in Anlehnung an deine Qualifikation und Erfahrung gegeben ist.

#### **Interessiert?**


Wenn du an dieser vielseitigen Position mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum interessiert bist, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!  

Hast du schon erste Fragen? Einige haben wir hier in den FAQs auf der Karriere\-Seite auf unserer Website schon beantwortet: https://www.schuhfried.com/de/karriere/

Petra Oswald\-Ulreich  

Head of People \& Organisation  

Tel.: \+43 2236 42315\-370

Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking an Application Identity Developer (Technical)
to support a federal program in Stuttgart, Germany.
The Application Identity Developer
will serve as a hands-on engineer responsible for developing, integrating, and securing enterprise applications within a large-scale Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) environment. This role is heavily focused on coding, authentication integrations, API development, automation, and troubleshooting complex identity solutions supporting mission-critical systems.

Responsibilities of the Application Identity Developer include:

Develop and maintain custom identity integrations using Python, Java, .NET, PowerShell, or similar technologies to support enterprise application onboarding and authentication workflows.
Build and configure secure application authentication solutions leveraging SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and federation technologies.
Design, develop, and troubleshoot REST APIs, identity broker integrations, and access management services supporting enterprise applications.
Implement authentication and authorization logic through PingFederate, PingAccess, F5 BIG-IP/APM, reverse proxies, and API gateway technologies.
Automate identity lifecycle, access provisioning, application integration, and validation processes using scripting and infrastructure automation tools.
Debug and resolve complex authentication, authorization, federation, and Single Sign-On (SSO) issues across distributed environments.
Collaborate with security engineers and application teams to implement Zero Trust access controls and modern ICAM enforcement capabilities.

Qualifications for the Application Identity Developer include:

8+ years of experience with Software Development focusing on Applications and IAM/ICAM environments
Experience with Python, Java, .NET, PowerShell, REST APIs, or similar programming technologies.
Strong knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Single Sign-On (SSO), and modern authentication architectures.
Experience with PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta, Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint, F5 BIG-IP/APM, or related identity technologies.
Active Secret Security Clearance required.
Bachelor's degree

Salary Range: $180,000 - $225,000 based on experience
Full Benefits Package: PTO, Paid Holidays, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Maternity Leave, Military Reserve Pay Offset

Zudem entwickeln wir innovative BDE- und MES-Systeme für „Smart Production“, von Industrie 4.0 Live-OEE Dashboards mit modernen Web-Technologien bis zu komplexen Schnittstellen für Anlagensteuerungen, Sensoren und Aktoren.
